description.value: Tonolli's Deli & Café is a breakfast-focused deli and café located on East Saanich Road in Sidney on British Columbia's Saanich Peninsula. The deli-and-café format suggests prepared foods alongside sit-down breakfast service. Its position along East Saanich Road places it on a corridor commonly ridden by cyclists touring the peninsula.
